suppress.notes: False positive: dependency-check reads the artifact version of the Spring Boot module jar "spring-boot-data-mongodb" (4.1.0, i.e. the Spring Boot release version) and matches it against the cpe:2.3:a:vmware:spring_data_mongodb CPE, which is versioned independently by the actual spring-data-mongodb library. The real spring-data-mongodb artifact pulled transitively is version 5.1.0, which is not in any affected range for CVE-2026-41717 (affected ranges top out at 5.0.5; see https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-41717). Only the spring_data_mongodb CPE match is suppressed here; the spring_boot CPE match on this same jar is left active so genuine Spring Boot 4.1.0 CVEs still fail the build.
